question: _______ is scheduled to host the International Cricket Council (ICC) Men's Cricket World Cup 2023.
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India**, as India is scheduled to host the International Cricket Council (ICC) Men's Cricket World Cup 2023.
 
• The event is a quadrennial international men's cricket championship, organized by the ICC. The first tournament was held in 1975 in England.
 
• England, has hosted the tournament on five occasions, the most recent being in 2019.
 
• New Zealand, has never hosted the Men's Cricket World Cup, but it co-hosted the tournament with Australia in 2015.
 
• Pakistan, has hosted the tournament once in 1987, when it was co-hosted with India and was known as the Reliance World Cup.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Cricket is governed globally by the International Cricket Council (ICC).
 
• Representatives from South Africa, Australia, and England established it as the Imperial Cricket Conference in 1909.
 
• Before assuming its current name in 1987, it was known as the International Cricket Conference in 1965. In Dubai, United Arab Emirates, the ICC is headquartered.
 
• Twelve Full Members who participate in Test matches and ninety-six Associate Members make up the ICC's current membership of 108 nations.
